In this video, I sit down with my Mexican friend to uncover the truth behind the dark origins of "Day of the Dead" and its deep connection to death rituals that glorify the dead and encourage communication with spirits—a practice known as necromancy. According to the Bible, communicating with the dead is strongly forbidden, as it opens the door to dangerous spiritual influences.

As Christians, it's essential to understand what we're being asked to celebrate and the spiritual implications behind these traditions. While many view the "Day of the Dead" as a cultural expression, its roots are deeply intertwined with practices that God warns us to avoid.
